title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Capabilities
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Capabilities practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

Customer

Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.

Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.

Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX & UI, and Marketing

Enterprise Value Creation

Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mind

title: Go-To-Market Recruiter (NYC or Chicago)
locationText: Chicago, Illinois; New York, New York
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

About the Role

Every great organization is built on its earlier-in-career talent, and at Everpure, that's especially true. Our SDRs, SMB Account Executives, Associate Sales Engineers, and Technical Post-Sales Support teams are the lifeblood of our growth. They're also tomorrow's AEs, SEs, and leaders, thanks to an internal mobility culture that turns ambition into real career trajectories. 

As our newest Go-To-Market Recruiter, you'll own the engine that brings that hires and nurtures these teams. You'll focus on emerging talent with anywhere from 1-5 years of industry experience to support high-velocity growth.

This is a high-impact, full-cycle role for a creative problem solver who thrives on momentum. You'll source your own pipelines, run the process end to end, advise hiring leaders on strategy, and close top talent. You'll also get to build: candidate funnels, new-grad hiring sprints, and in-office events that create real buzz for Everpure among emerging talent.

You'll join a tight-knit, world-class team of recruiters doing some of the best work in the industry, in a company with amazing culture and leadership. You'll learn from the best, get real ownership from day one, and help shape how we hire at scale.

How You Work

• Creative problem solver : You see obstacles as puzzles, find inventive routes to the right talent, and don't wait for perfect conditions to make things happen

• Team player : You share what you learn, lift others up, and jump in when a teammate needs help

• Self-starter : You spot problems and opportunities before you're asked

• Adaptable : You're a Swiss Army knife who's energized by variety and happy to take on whatever the moment calls for

• Growth-minded : You're hungry to learn new functions, roles, and tools

What You'll Do

• Own early-career GTM hiring for SDR, SMB Account Executive, Associate Sales Engineer, and Technical Post-Sales Support teams, running pipelines end to end from intake to offer acceptance - teams are based in-office in Chicago, IL; Lehi, UT; Raleigh, NC.

• Be a full-cycle sourcing powerhouse . You'll build pipelines through outbound, referrals, communities, and inventive channels nobody else is tapping.

• Build candidate funnels for today and tomorrow, balancing immediate hiring needs with talent pools that set us up for future demand.

• Plan and run hiring events, including in-office events timed around graduation windows, that generate energy and convert emerging talent.

• Be a strategic partner to hiring teams . Advise sales and technical leaders on role definition, market realities, interview design, and candidate experience, and push back with data when it matters.

• Raise the bar on quality . Apply our competency-based interviewing and scorecard processes consistently to hire for potential, not just pedigree.

• Negotiate and close with confidence, reading candidate motivations and winning against competing offers.

• Put AI to work. Use tools like Claude and Gemini to sharpen sourcing, outreach, process automation, and insights.

• Communicate relentlessly. Keep stakeholders informed with proactive updates, even when the update is "no change yet".

• Be our utility player. Pitch in across roles, functions, and initiatives as priorities shift, and grow your skills in the process.

What You Bring

Must-haves

• 3+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in sales or GTM hiring (or the ability to ramp quickly

title: Graphic Designer II - Special Projects

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. • A strong collaborator with excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience building presentation decks or mockups for external-facing reviews

title: Event Manager
description:
Western Door Federal is part of the S eneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. SNG is Seneca Holdings ’ federal government contracting business that meets mission-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.
Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.
Western Door Federal is seeking an Event Manager. In this role, the Event Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing chaplain-led events worldwide in support of the U.S. Army Chief of Chaplains’ Building Strong & Ready Teams (BSRT) / Strong Bonds program. This role ensures successful delivery of Standard and Specialized Logistical Support Packages (LSPs), which may include meeting space, lodging, meals, childcare, transportation, audiovisual, curriculum, external presenters, and on-site administrative support.
Key Duties & Responsibilities

•
Event Coordination & Logistics

• Manage full lifecycle of events listed on the Authorized Event List (AEL), ensuring compliance with timelines, standards, and cost controls.

• Secure and oversee meeting space, lodging, food, audiovisual support, childcare, transportation, curriculum, and training activities.

• Coordinate external presenters and ensure readiness for scheduled event delivery.

• Provide on-site administrative support including registration, room setup, training material distribution, name badges, attendance tracking, and certificates.

•
Program Administration

• Process event requests, attendee registrations, and travel requirements.

• Submit required deliverables including Monthly Execution Reports, Quarterly Close-Out Reports, Receipts of Services, and Invoices.

• Maintain event data, compliance documentation, and financial reconciliation.

•
Compliance & Standards

• Ensure services comply with applicable Army Regulations, FAR/JTR travel rules, childcare protection laws, and federal/state/local standards.

• Meet Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs) outlined in the PWS (e.g., 95-100% compliance for lodging, childcare, audiovisual uptime, and food standards).

• Manage vendor background checks and incident reporting as required.

•
Stakeholder Coordination

• Liaise with Unit Ministry Teams (UMTs), event leaders, program administrators, and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR).

• Deliver roles and responsibilities briefings at events to inform participants of contractor support expectations.

• Attend quarterly reviews and progress meetings with the COR/KO.

Required Qualifications

•
Education & Experience

• Minimum 5 years of event planning experience , including 3 years supporting senior-level (General Officer / SES / Corporate) events .

• Experience managing federal government events or equivalent.

• Proven background in large-scale, multi-location event logistics.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst - Köln
description:
Du fühlst dich im Vertrieb zu Hause und möchtest ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufbauen und verantworten? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
description:
Who we are:
At Focused, we move quickly to deliver quality software that achieves client outcomes and meets their customer's needs. We strategically partner with our clients to leverage our expertise in design and software, while our clients bring their own domain expertise. We work with a variety of clients from different industries, collaborating as we get new products to market, modernizing legacy systems, or helping teams learn the skills they need to be successful.

Our values:

Listen first • We are experts in product practices but life long learners in the domain of our customers. We research, collaborate, and understand.
Learn why • We ask questions and talk to users to understand problem spaces, objectives, and goals, which allows us to deeply invest and drive towards the outcomes of our clients.
Love your craft • We love diving into a variety of domains and solving problems. We take pride in delivering value, in communicating progress, and guiding our clients to success.

At Focused, we care about building culture as much as building software. This role runs our 10-person Denver office and serves as right hand to our CEO. You'll make our LoDo office a place people want to come to, and keep our CEO organized, on schedule, and following through across work, family, and board commitments. As the role grows, you'll take on operations across all Focused offices.

What would you be doing?

• Getting to know everyone in the office, what they like, what they don't, and what they need, and keeping the office stocked with snacks, drinks, and supplies to match

• Planning monthly happy hours and quarterly team events

• Owning new-hire facilities onboarding like badges and keys

• Keeping the office clean, tidy, and working, from taking out the trash to coordinating repairs

• Running the CEO's inbox, calendar, and travel end to end, using AI tools and automations to move faster

• Keeping the CEO on task by tracking commitments, following up persistently, and making sure things get finished

• Supporting personal and family logistics, family travel, and nonprofit board work

• As workload allows, taking on events and offsites, onboarding and offboarding logistics, and gifting and celebrations across all Focused offices

We are excited about you, because you:

• Have 3+ years as an executive assistant, office manager, or in a similar role supporting a senior leader

• Are sharp, organized, and persistent, and you follow up until things are done

• Are AI-forward. You already use AI tools every day and want to push them further

• Are warm and energetic, with clear writing and discretion around confidential business and personal information

• Have a reliable vehicle, valid driver's license, and auto insurance, plus the ability to carry supplies up to 25 lbs

Nice to have:

• Experience supporting a founder or CEO

• Experience planning events

• Experience supporting nonprofit board work

If you had worked at Focused over the last 3 months you may have:

• Stocked the office around what each person actually likes

• Hosted a quarterly event people talked about for weeks

• Built an AI-assisted inbox and follow-up system that saves the CEO hours each week

• Booked a multi-city business trip and a family vacation in the same week

What to know before you apply:

• This is a full-time, hourly position based in our LoDo office in Denver.

• This role is in office Tuesday through Thursday and remote Monday and Friday, with occasional evenings for team happy hours and events.

• Focused is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

• The pay range is $25 to $40 per hour, based on experience. This role is also eligible for Focused's benefits package.

title: Spring 2027 Business Operations Internship/Co-op

As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. If you’ve demonstrated a commitment to academic success and motivation to apply your knowledge outside of the classroom, you are a great candidate!  

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. • 3+ months experience in corporate and business functions (data analysis, finance, human resources, IT, gove rnment affairs, legal, advertising, and sales is applicable)

• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

• Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Business Operations Intern/Freshman/Sophomore: $24.50 USD per hour      Business Operations Intern/Junior/Senior: $25 USD per hour   Business Operations Intern/Completed Bachelor's: $25 USD per hour   Business Operations Intern/Completed Master's: $26 USD per hour  

Your salary will be determined by academic level. Hourly pay is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI. You may also be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs, as well as access to our comprehensive medical coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.

Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. May Mobility is seeking a Lead, Safety Assurance to serve as the company's primary authority on autonomous vehicle safety compliance. description:
DIRECTOR, AI & DATA SCIENCE
Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science | Full-Time, Salaried | Player-Coach | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA

Team

Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred.

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 base

Schedule

Collaboration across time zones. Regular working-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required.

Travel

Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role
Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds.
You will lead our combined Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself.
Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results.
Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them.
This role is for someone who manages a hands-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading.
What You Will Do
1. Set the foundation in your first 30 days

• Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it.

• Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps.

• Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix.

2. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%

• Test the AI and our moderators on the same held-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals.

• Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback.

3. Build systems that keep getting better

• Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test.

• Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back.

4. Run production AI like a business

• Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills.

• Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance.

title: Senior Actuarial Analyst
description:
About the Role
Location: Fully remote within the continental United States.
Use of AI data in insurance pricing entails regulatory review by state departments of insurance. When a carrier intends to use Nearmap data in its rates, both the carrier’s own actuaries and state insurance regulators can come back with various questions and/or objections. Many are predictable and specific: how was ground truth for an attribute determined, what do the goodness-of-fit metrics look like on held-out data? Others have never been asked before and have yet to be fully answered.
You will be the actuarial voice inside Nearmap ’s and our customers’ rate filings. Working with our AI and Computer Vision team, you will build a library of validation materials behind every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating, produce exhibits and memos for state DOI review, and answer regulator objections with analysis that holds up under scrutiny.
This is a customer-facing actuarial role, not a back-office one. You will report into Insurance Product and work alongside our regulatory affairs owner, who owns regulator relationships and submission mechanics, so your time goes to the analysis and the defense of it.
Key Responsibilities
You’ll own and defend the filing evidence:

• Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to produce the filing materials for each Nearmap attribute and score used in rating: model memos, validation and accuracy metrics, and the actuarial exhibits that go into a submission.

• Document and maintain what each state requires for model validation, including details on state-by-state confidentiality and trade secret treatments, ensuring Nearmap consistently produces exhibits that satisfies the NAIC checklist for model filings

• Turn model outputs into the evidence that filings need, such as model validation metrics, coverage rates, distributional analysis, bias and fairness testing, and by-state breakdowns. Lead the analytical response to regulator objections, working with our regulatory affairs owner on strategy, framing, and submission, and join calls with departments of insurance to explain methodology and results directly.

• Manage administration of Nearmap ’s filings including creating and maintaining SERFF accounts and keeping good records of all Nearmap filing materials and exchanges.

You'll work directly with customers:

• Advise on which attributes are filing-ready and which carry approval risk and build supporting materials to enable the GTM teams and customers ahead of time.

• Partner with carrier actuarial and pricing teams on how Nearmap data is best implemented in their rating plans.

• Collaborate with pre-sales to support data tests and lift analyses that demonstrate predictive value and help turn the results into something a filing can use.

You'll make the next filing cheaper than the last:

• Build reusable validation templates and exhibits so each new carrier program costs less effort than the one before it.

• Establish product requirements for new products and scores before they ship that makes them “filing ready” immediately upon release.

Experience

• 5+ years of property and casualty actuarial experience, with real exposure to pricing, ratemaking, or rate filings.

• ACAS or FCAS credentialing strongly preferred for this role. Candidates with substantial ratemaking and filing experience will be considered.

• Experience preparing actuarial exhibits for rate filings and responding to regulator objections.

• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.

Skills

• You can explain carrier-led rate filing processes to someone who is not an actuary without making them feel lost.

• You are comfortable with predictive model output, including GLMs, gradient boosting, and the validation statistics that go with them.

• You have worked with large claims and exposure data using standard tooling including SQL, R, or Python.

title: DevOps Engineer* Linux
description:

In unseren Projekten verwenden wir häufig folgende Technologien:

• Linux, Systemd, containerd, Bash

• OpenTofu, Ansible, Gitlab CI, Argo CD, Grafana Stack, Prometheus

• Kubernetes, Helm, Trivy, Falco, Go

• AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, STACKIT

Intern wie extern kannst du dich bei uns auf vielfältige Art einbringen: Deinen anfangs gewählten technologischen Schwerpunkt kannst du jederzeit verlagern. Als Expert:in im Bereich Engineering hast du außerdem die Möglichkeit, jüngere Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring zu unterstützen.
Requirements
Wer gut zu uns passen würde
Ob du ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen hast, ist für uns nebensächlich - für uns zählen deine fachlichen Skills und deine Persönlichkeit:

• Auf der Linux-Kommandozeile fühlst du dich zu Hause. Systemd, Networking, Storage und Prozessmanagement beherrschst du sicher.

• CI/CD-Pipelines hast du bisher nicht nur genutzt, sondern selbst gebaut, optimiert und debuggt. Außerdem kannst du Infrastructure-as-Code routiniert einsetzen.

• Du verfügst über tiefe Kenntnisse in der Containerisierung sowie deren Orchestrierung und bist routiniert darin, Anwendungen in entsprechenden Umgebungen effizient zu betreiben.

• Wie Entwicklungsteams arbeiten, verstehst du und gestaltest Prozesse und Toolchains so, dass sie den Weg von der lokalen Entwicklung bis zum Production-Deployment vereinfachen.

The Role
As our Regional Manager of Network Operations for APAC, you will be the guardian of our service continuity across the region, orchestrating the end-to-end restoration of critical telecommunications and technology incidents. Your expertise ensures that our regional network remains resilient, specifically focusing on European, Middle Eastern, and African carriers to directly impact the "peace of mind" we promise to our travellers.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end incident lifecycle for Holafly ’s global connectivity services, from detection and impact assessment through technical investigation, service restoration, customer recovery validation and closure.

• Act as Incident Commander for major network incidents, coordinating L1/L2 teams, MNOs, IMSI providers, IPX/GRX partners and core-network vendors while maintaining clear technical ownership until resolution.

• Lead and develop a team of 5-10 Network Operations engineers, providing technical mentoring, escalation guidance, performance management and ensuring strong operational readiness across the team.

• Maintain deep technical ownership of live roaming and core-network services, including Diameter/DRA/HSS, GTP-C/GTP-U, PGW/PCRF, APN/DNS, IPX/GRX, routing, Local Breakout and 4G/5G connectivity, with the ability to independently analyse traces, logs and network behaviour.

• Drive RCA, Problem Management and permanent corrective actions for major and recurring incidents, ensuring root causes are identified, vendor responses are challenged where required, and preventive improvements are completed.

• Own network performance, monitoring and operational improvement, using KPIs such as first-attach success, session-establishment success, latency, packet loss, throughput, availability and MTTR, while ensuring seamless follow-the-sun handover between regional teams.

Qualifications

• 15+ years of experience in Mobile Telecommunications, with strong exposure to Core Network, International Roaming, Packet Core, IMSI/SIM technologies, IPX/GRX and mobile data services.

• Strong technical knowledge of LTE/4G and 5G NSA/SA roaming architectures, including Diameter/DRA/HSS, GTP-C/GTP-U, PGW/PCRF, APN/DNS, routing and Local Breakout environments.

• Proven experience leading major network incidents and technical troubleshooting, with the ability to analyse signalling traces, PCAPs, logs and network KPIs and drive incidents through restoration, RCA and permanent corrective action.

• Previous people-management experience, ideally leading a Network Operations, NOC, Core Network or Incident Management team of approximately 5-10 engineers, with responsibility for mentoring, performance and technical development.

• Strong understanding of IP networking and roaming connectivity, including BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, NAT, IPX/GRX, Diameter and associated troubleshooting methodologies.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills in English, with the ability to coordinate global MNOs, IMSI providers, IPX/core vendors and internal teams, challenge technical responses and communicate complex incidents clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Certifications in AWS, Cisco, or Project Management (PMP/Agile).

• Knowledge of eSIM orchestration and GSMA standards.

title: Manager, ML Solutions Architecture - Token Factory
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role
This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack.
Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward.

Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support : the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region.
We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three.
You're welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Lead the team

• Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest

• Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do

• Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions

• Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement

• Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope

Own delivery

• Be accountable for your team's delivery outcomes: time from PoC kick-off to first optimized dedicated endpoint, success-criteria hit rate, and the quality of the technical relationship after the customer goes to production

• Review technical work before it reaches the customer: benchmarking methodology, serving configurations, results, closure documents; catch the wrong conclusion drawn from a metrics artifact before a customer sees it

• Ensure staffing and escalation coverage across accounts and timezones, including post-sales request load that does not respect sprint boundaries

• Call infeasibility early and with evidence, rather than letting the team burn iterations against requirements the platform cannot meet today

Fresh Clinics empowers nurses and doctors to run thriving, compliant, and modern healthcare practices through our native iOS App, medical oversight, and human support behind them.
We're Australian founded, and in 7 years grown to 170+ Freshie's and support +2000 clinicians across Australia, and now scaling fast in the USA; all whilst staying true to what matters most: building safe, sustainable hybrid healthcare.
We're proud finalists in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 three years in a row and our culture is as bold as our mission: We work smart, hustle hard, stay humble, and lead with kindness.
If you’re looking for a workplace that celebrates our people, drives real-world impact, and champions innovation - welcome home.

About the role

We are seeking a highly responsive Medical Director to join our team as a dedicated physician partner. Fresh acts as the bridge between independent aesthetic practitioners and the complex regulatory landscape. In this role, you will provide medical governance and oversight for multiple practices and providers across the country , operating within state-specific regulatory limits.
This role is designed for a clinician who wants to move away from the "absentee" model and toward a "gold standard" of oversight that is reliable and deeply integrated into member safety. You will serve as the clinical safety net, providing the necessary authority for members to legally perform procedures and order professional-grade supplies.

Protocol Approval: Approve and oversee clinical protocols for treatments including botulinum toxin, dermal fillers, IV therapy, and laser services.

•
Operational Partnership: Support the Ops team by providing timely signatures and mandatory training certifications to get member supplier accounts active.

•
Chart Auditing: Log into the EMR to review a randomized 10% of patient charts monthly to ensure documentation standards are met.

•

•
Clinical Community: Attend ongoing webinars and the monthly USA Doctors’ “Morbidity and Most-Excellent-cases” meeting.

We'd love you to have

•
Multi-State Licensure: Must hold an active MD or DO license in good standing. Holding licenses in multiple states is highly preferred (top 10 states preferred) .

•
Aesthetic Experience: Ideally 2+ years of exposure to aesthetic medicine (either as a practitioner or director).

•
Regulatory Knowledge: Basic knowledge of state-specific laws regarding delegation and supervision (Fresh provides internal management of complex regulatory landscapes).

•
Remote Proficiency: Experience using EMRs for chart auditing and the ability to manage digital signatures with 100% accuracy.

•
Board Certification: MD or DO in good standing; specialties like Plastic Surgery, Dermatology, or Family Medicine are ideal.

•
Insurance: Must carry malpractice insurance as required by state laws.

Who you are

•
A Senior Executor: You value your time and appreciate a model that automates administrative headaches so you can provide oversight from your laptop.

•
A Clinical Professional: You can quickly review a patient chart and identify if a safety risk exists.

We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?
Redis is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to shape how engineers, and the AI agents working alongside them, use Redis. Our team builds the surfaces developers touch every day: the Redis Cloud console, Redis Insight, and the agentic layer of MCP servers, CLIs and agent skills that let an AI agent create, configure and work with Redis end to end. Our users are engineers, and so are we, so we hold a high bar for usability, performance and developer experience. AI-native is how we already work: agents write essentially all of our code and act as first responders on GitHub issues, alerts and failing tests, and every product idea starts as a working prototype. - Build agentic interfaces to Redis, such as MCP servers, CLIs and agent skills, so that anything a user can do in the UI, an agent can do too.

- Make agent-driven development reliable through quality gates, CI, eval harnesses and review practices.

- Work across team boundaries with backend, platform and product teams to ship cohesive experiences.

- 6+ years of experience building and shipping production software.

- A track record of leading initiatives to completion and aligning a team around clear solutions.

- A product mindset: you measure success by adoption and user value, not by how many PRs you merged.

- Ability to pick up new technologies and domains quickly.

- Ability to thrive at pace across several parallel initiatives: you keep the context, write decisions down, raise disagreement before a decision is made, and commit once it is.

- Clear English communication skills and ability to work across distributed teams.

- 25 days of vacation time

- Home internet & phone monthly allowance

- Health and dental insurance for you

- Personal life insurance

Senior AWS Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior AWS Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000-$170,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate large-scale, secure, and highly available cloud platforms on Amazon Web Services. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role spanning architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security, observability, and continuous operational improvement of mission-critical production workloads. The successful candidate will bring strong working knowledge of the AWS service portfolio, deep DevOps fundamentals, and a pragmatic, cost-aware design mindset, and will partner with application, security, and SRE teams to deliver resilient, cloud-native solutions that scale with the business.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on AWS in production environments.

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, and CloudFormation.

• Production-grade experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.

• Solid experience designing and operating Amazon EKS or ECS clusters at scale.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines across infrastructure and application workloads.

• Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash, with familiarity in Go or PowerShell considered a plus.

• Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, key management, and compliance requirements.

• Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and alerting in cloud-native environments.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or DevOps Engineer - Professional certification.

• Experience with multi-account AWS Organizations and centralized governance.

• Familiarity with service mesh, eBPF-based observability, and zero-trust networking.

• Exposure to FinOps practices and well-architected cost-optimization frameworks.

• Experience operating regulated workloads (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, FedRAMP).

How to Apply

title: Engineering Manager - Control Plane Platform Engineer
description:

The Control Plane Platform team is building the shared foundation that every product in ClickHouse Cloud is built and shipped on. We give ClickHouse engineering teams one place to own and deploy their product, remove the overhead of rebuilding common plumbing, and keep the customer experience consistent as the number of integrating teams grows. The team owns API gateways and API standards, shared platform services, deployment and infrastructure patterns, testing and CI, local developer experience and Control Plane observability.

About the role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform team. This is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of our Cloud product, combining people leadership, technical direction, product thinking, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and engineering teams across ClickHouse.

This role goes beyond engineering leadership. Together with your team, you’ll help shape how new products and teams will integrate and deploy their applications in ClickHouse Cloud.

What You’ll Do

- Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team - recruit to a high bar, set crisp expectations, give direct feedback and career development, and manage performance - while fostering a healthy, inclusive environment built on empathy, psychological safety, trust, and a high technical bar.

- Own outcomes across the platform surface: API gateways and API standards, shared platform services (event bus, notifications, feature flags, websockets, audit records), deployment and infrastructure patterns, CI and testing, local developer experience, disaster recovery, and Control Plane observability.

- Treat the integrating teams as your customers and measure success by their delivery velocity and adoption of the platform, not only by what your team ships.

- Jump into designs and code for complex areas - gateway routing and auth/RBAC enforcement, spec-driven code generation, event delivery semantics and idempotency, multi-region rollout safety.

- Build the culture of operational excellence: Own SLOs, reliability, on-call quality, and cost-efficiency for k8s-hosted, multi-tenant services across cloud regions.

- Systematize support, reduce toil, and build self-serve/auto-healing capabilities - golden-path templates and generators, auto-healing, and documentation that gets a new team integrated in days rather than weeks.

- Shape the platform vision, turn it into a roadmap, sequence bets for business impact, and ship fast with tight feedback loops - including writing the RFCs that build cross-org consensus before big changes land

What you bring

- 8+ years in software engineering and 3+ years managing software engineers with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent.

- Experience leading distributed global teams, fostering an inclusive and autonomous culture, and creating clarity across time zones.

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Fundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce. Our customers are lenders and loan servicers who use Fundingo to run their day-to-day operations. Our delivery team works directly with those customers, building custom implementations, integrations, and data migrations that fit Fundingo to how each customer runs their business.
As a Salesforce Technical Lead, you'll set the technical direction for our delivery projects. You'll make the architecture decisions, own our Git-based development process and code standards, review the team's code, and direct the work of the Salesforce developers on each project. You'll also take part in internal strategy discussions and join sales conversations with prospective clients who need integration expertise.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with development in Apex and Lightning Web Components as the primary focus. You’ll also lead technical design, review code, and guide developers on assigned delivery projects. The balance will vary based on project complexity and team needs.
You'll direct the developers' work on your projects, but this isn't a people-management role: developers don't report to you, and you won't handle things like time-off requests. It is also not an admin or configuration role.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

title: Software Engineer — Full-Stack (.NET / Java / Python / React)
description:
About CompSci
CompSci LLC is a hybrid onshore/nearshore technology services firm with about 100 people working across roughly 22 active client engagements. Our engineers embed with client teams in healthcare, education, insurance, and SaaS, building new products and modernizing the systems those businesses run on.
We treat AI-assisted and agentic development as a core part of how we deliver, not an experiment. Engineers here work with defined standards, automated quality gates, and modern pipelines.
The role
We're hiring a full-stack software engineer who is productive across several stacks: .NET/C#, Java, Python, React, and relational databases. You'll be placed on a client engagement and may move between engagements over time, so range matters as much as depth.
Some projects are greenfield. Others are long-lived platforms on older frameworks, including .NET Framework 4.x and ASP.NET Web Forms, that need careful modernization. We want someone equally comfortable in both.

• Location: Remote; US or nearshore (Latin America)

• Hours: Substantial overlap with US Central Time

• English: Professional fluency, spoken and written; you'll work directly with US clients

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services in C#/.NET, Java, and Python, and front ends in React with TypeScript.

• Model data, write efficient SQL, and tune queries and schemas for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.

• Modernize legacy applications incrementally, keeping production stable while moving to current frameworks.

• Build and consume REST APIs and integrations with third-party and partner systems.

• Use AI coding tools and agents within our team standards, and review their output with the same rigor as human code.

• Write unit and integration tests, and keep CI/CD pipelines green.

• Deploy to and troubleshoot cloud environments, primarily AWS, with some Azure.

• Work directly with client stakeholders: clarify requirements, estimate work, and explain trade-offs in plain language.

• Review peers' code and mentor less experienced engineers.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software development, shipping production code.

• .NET/C#: Production experience with modern .NET (6 or later), plus working familiarity with .NET Framework.

• Java: Production experience, ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.

• Python: Comfortable writing services, scripts, and data tooling.

• React: Strong React with TypeScript, including state management and component design.

• Databases: Solid SQL and relational design, with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL in production.

• Hands-on use of AI coding assistants in daily work, with a clear view of where they help and where they fail.

• Automated testing (for example xUnit, JUnit, pytest, Jest) and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical people.

We don't expect equal depth in every language. We do expect you to be productive in all of them and expert in at least two.

• Legacy migrations, such as Web Forms or WCF to ASP.NET Core, or a monolith to services.

• Next.js, Node.js, or NestJS.

• AWS infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), plus Docker.

• NoSQL or caching layers such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis.

• Regulated domains: healthcare (HIPAA, EHR), education, or insurance.

• Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

• Technical leadership: leading a small team, running design reviews, or interviewing engineers.

• Code quality and security tooling such as SonarQube or SAST scanners.

What we offer

• Your choice of full-time W-2 employment with standard benefits or a 1099 contract arrangement.

• Compensation set by experience and geographic region.

• Real variety: different clients, domains, and stacks, with room to move between engagements.

title: Media Buyer RO
description:
About HIGHSCALE

We're HIGHSCALE , a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing how brands advertise on TV and social media. Think Amazon's customer obsession meets SpaceX's fearless innovation.
Our 120-person team spans creatives, strategists, editors, and analysts, powering thousands of high-performance video ads for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands every week. With 50,000 sq. ft. of studios in DTLA and an international network of creators and influencers, we're scaling fast, and we're building our media buying team in Romania to help us amplify that growth across global markets.
Why This Role Matters
Every viral campaign starts with precision targeting and flawless media execution. As a Media Buyer, you'll turn creative excellence into performance results, deploying millions in ad spend across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms for US brands.
You'll combine analytical rigor with creative intuition, ensuring every dollar spent fuels data-driven learning and exponential brand growth.
What You'll Do
Launch & Optimize Campaigns

• Plan, execute, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms.

• Manage budgets, bidding strategies, and audience targeting to maximize ROI.

• Continuously A/B test creatives, audiences, and placements to identify scalable winners.

Analyze & Report Performance

• Track and interpret campaign data daily to identify performance trends.

• Build and present reports highlighting insights, learnings, and optimization strategies.

• Translate numbers into actionable strategies for creative and strategy teams.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

• Work closely with creative, production, and strategy teams to ensure ads are optimized for performance and storytelling.

• Provide feedback loops between creative and data, informing what works and what doesn't.

• Support the strategy team in developing media plans and client recommendations.

Scale Efficiently

• Manage and scale ad accounts with 5 to 6 figures in monthly spend.

• Identify growth opportunities and emerging channels to stay ahead of the competition.

• Proactively propose testing strategies and budget reallocations to maximize performance.

Stay Ahead of Trends

• Keep up to date with algorithm updates, platform best practices, and performance marketing innovations.

• Experiment with new ad formats and beta programs to drive early adopter advantage.

Who You Are
Performance-Driven

• 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns.

• Proven track record in performance marketing, ideally for eCommerce, fashion, or beauty brands.

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable reading metrics, building reports, and identifying growth levers.

Data-Savvy

• Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, and analytics tools.

• Bonus: hands-on experience with Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP) or full Amazon listing management.

• Bonus: DV360 or other programmatic platform experience.

Creative & Strategic

• Understands what makes content perform: able to connect audience psychology with ad messaging.

• Loves blending storytelling with numbers to drive conversions.

Fast & Adaptable

• Thrives in a high-speed environment where priorities shift daily.

• Excels at managing multiple campaigns and deadlines with precision.

Collaborative & Communicative

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• Based in Romania and available to work 9am to 6pm PST, Monday to Friday, alongside our LA team.

Perks & Benefits

• Remote Role: Work with global teams from anywhere in Romania.

• Growth Opportunities: Chance to lead media buying strategy for global DTC brands as we build out the Romanian team.

• Profit-Sharing & Stock Options: Be part of our shared success as we scale.

Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented Customer Support Representative with a strong financial background to join a fast-growing U.S.-based fintech company. The company offers a cashback and payments app that lets users earn money back on everyday purchases by buying instant digital gift cards at checkout. In this role, you will support customers and partners on account, payment, and transaction inquiries, including high-value money movements, and deliver accurate, timely resolutions that build trust in the platform. Funding, Ecosystem, and External Voice
